correctness.rationale: Every scale-two cross-arm edge lies in one of two cone cliques; local Rips sixcycles are octahedral 2-spheres intersecting the common cone in contractible cones. The equivariant cone collapse yields an actual wedge of quotient spheres. Signed determinant calculation gives the integral permutation-sign lattice. The reflection is a linear octahedral mirror with disk quotient; its invariant cone subspace collapses, proving contractible full orbit. Reproduction code checks full finite face equalities, mod-2 Betti and signed traces through h=6; the proof is uniform and does not infer infinite properties from finite ranks.
